description: The navigation shell: NavProvider state context, AccountControls extracted from Header, the Nav bar, PageRouter, and SignInGate, with App wrapping NavProvider and rendering Nav + PageRouter. This is the PREREQUISITE shell for the Absences and Reviewers pages (FEAT-005/006). State-based page switching, no react-router. Grounded in design.md OD-1 and Components -> Navigation. Depends on FEAT-002 (no hard import yet, but keeps the shell building before features land).
steps: Create src/context/NavProvider.tsx exposing { page: 'board' | 'absences' | 'reviewers'; setPage } via context, pattern-matching src/context/SessionProvider.tsx / ThemeProvider.tsx (createContext + a useNav() hook that throws outside the provider).

Extract src/components/AccountControls.tsx from src/components/Header.tsx: move the Appearance button + AppearancePanel modal, the officer-only Members button + AdminPanel modal, the account-name span, the sign-in/sign-out button + AuthDialog modal, and the showAuth/showAdmin/showAppearance useState hooks and handleSignOut into AccountControls. Preserve the exact token styles and sr/aria labels. Header keeps the logo + title and composes <AccountControls />.

Create src/components/Nav.tsx: a themed top row of three real <button>s (Board / Absences / Reviewers) wired to setPage, each with aria-current='page' on the active one; compose <AccountControls />. Leave a slot/placeholder for the officer pending badge on Absences (wired by FEAT-005). Tokens only; global focus ring.

Create src/components/PageRouter.tsx switching on page -> <Layout /> (board) | <AbsencesPage /> | <ReviewersPage />. Create minimal placeholder src/components/AbsencesPage.tsx and src/components/ReviewersPage.tsx (each gated via useSession: render SignInGate when signed out, otherwise a 'coming soon' stub) so this feature builds; FEAT-005/006 replace them.
Create src/components/SignInGate.tsx: a short prompt + a 'Sign in' button that opens AuthDialog inside the shared Modal; reads live useSession so it re-renders to/from the gate on auth change.
Update src/App.tsx to wrap NavProvider inside ThemeProvider (NavProvider between ThemeProvider and the content) and render <Nav /> above <PageRouter /> instead of <Layout /> directly.

Keep Header.test.tsx green: if the extraction moved an element that a test asserts on, update the test to assert against the same element now rendered via AccountControls, preserving the original assertions (do not weaken them).
acceptance_criteria: NavProvider, Nav, AccountControls, PageRouter, SignInGate exist; Header composes AccountControls and no auth/appearance/members control is duplicated between Header and Nav.
App renders Nav + PageRouter; switching nav buttons changes the page and sets aria-current on the active button.
AbsencesPage/ReviewersPage placeholders render SignInGate when signed out.
No react-router or any new runtime dependency is added.
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test` and confirm both pass (Header.test.tsx included, adjusted only to track the extraction with equivalent assertions).
Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds.
Confirm package.json dependencies are unchanged (no new runtime dep).
findings:
Navigation shell landed, no new runtime dep (package.json/package-lock.json unchanged). Verification green: typecheck 0 errors, 152 passed / 9 skipped (RLS integration suite skips as expected with no live backend), build OK.

New files: src/context/NavProvider.tsx (exposes { page: 'board'|'absences'|'reviewers'; setPage } via useNav(); Page type is exported from here), src/components/AccountControls.tsx, Nav.tsx, PageRouter.tsx, SignInGate.tsx, AbsencesPage.tsx, ReviewersPage.tsx. Modified: Header.tsx (now just logo+title + <AccountControls/>), App.tsx (SessionProvider > ThemeProvider > NavProvider > Nav + PageRouter), Header.test.tsx (renders AccountControls now; same assertions).

For later features:
- FEAT-005 (absences): REPLACE the stub body in src/components/AbsencesPage.tsx (keep the useSession gate -> SignInGate when signed out). Wire the officer pending-count badge into Nav: in src/components/Nav.tsx the Absences entry in NAV_ITEMS has a `badge` slot (currently null) rendered right after the label inside the button; set it to the live count element.
- FEAT-006 (reviewers): REPLACE the stub body in src/components/ReviewersPage.tsx (keep the same gate).
- SignInGate accepts an optional `message` prop for page-specific copy.
- Note: on the board page both Nav and Layout's Header render AccountControls (two copies of the account cluster), per design.md OD-1 which keeps Layout/Header intact for the board. If a later pass wants a single cluster, that is a design decision outside FEAT-003's scope.
